mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, request_id, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, user_name, phone, address, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, delivery_time, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status) values (#{number}, #{requestId}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{consignee}, #{cancelReason}, #{rejectionReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus})
mapper.select: select od.name, sum(od.number) from order_detail od, orders o where od.order_id = o.id and o.status = 5 and o.order_time > #{begin} and o.order_time < #{end} group by name order by sum(od.number) desc limit 0, 10
